title: ENFORCE: Nonlinear Constrained Learning with Adaptive-depth Neural Projection
abstract: arXiv:2502.06774v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Ensuring neural networks adhere to domain-specific constraints is crucial for addressing safety and trustworthiness while also enhancing inference accuracy. Despite the nonlinear nature of most real-world tasks, the majority of existing methods are limited to affine (equality) or convex (inequality) constraints. We introduce ENFORCE, a neural network architecture that uses an adaptive projection module (AdaNP) to enforce nonlinear equality and inequality constraints in the predictions up to a specified tolerance $\varepsilon$, and exactly in the affine-in-$y$ case. For affine constraint sets, we prove that the associated projection mapping is non-expansive (1-Lipschitz), ensuring stable gradient propagation. For nonlinear constraints, we establish local convergence analysis under standard regularity conditions. translated_title: ENFORCE：基于自适应深度神经投影的非线性约束学习
translated_abstract: 确保神经网络遵循特定领域的约束，对于解决安全性与可信性问题至关重要，同时还能提升推理精度。尽管大多数现实任务具有非线性特性，但现有方法大多仅限于仿射（等式）或凸（不等式）约束。我们提出了ENFORCE，这是一种神经网络架构，其采用自适应深度投影模块（AdaNP），使预测在指定容差 ε 内满足非线性等式和不等式约束，并且在仿射（关于y）情形下可精确满足约束。对于仿射约束集，我们证明了相应的投影映射是非扩张的（1-Lipschitz），从而确保梯度传播的稳定性。对于非线性约束，我们在标准正则性条件下建立了局部收敛性分析。我们在多个任务上评估了ENFORCE，包括函数拟合、实际工程案例研究以及学习优化问题。
tldr: 提出了ENFORCE神经网络架构，通过自适应深度神经投影模块（AdaNP）使预测在指定容差内满足非线性等式与不等式约束，并从理论上证明了仿射约束下投影的非扩张性（保证梯度稳定传播）及非线性约束下的局部收敛性。
